mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS supplier_name, b.bill_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM scm_rebate r LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = r.supplier_id LEFT JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = r.bill_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scm_rebate_tier WHERE rebate_id = #{rebateId} ORDER BY min_amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_rebate_tier (rebate_id, min_amount, rate) VALUES (#{rebateId}, #{t.minAmount}, #{t.rate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scm_rebate_item WHERE rebate_id = #{rebateId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_rebate_item (rebate_id, item_name, brand, category, amount, remark) VALUES (#{rebateId}, #{i.itemName}, #{i.brand}, #{i.category}, #{i.amount}, #{i.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rebate_amount), 0) FROM scm_rebate WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND kind = 'SALES' AND status = 'SETTLED' AND settle_mode = 'NEXT_ORDER'
